index.name: Edvvrdd Reaper tools for Game audio

reapack.name: ReaBlender.lua
reapack.desc: ReaBlender — multiband LR4 rig + granular whoosh suite

metadata.description: Unified Sound/Dev/Ed sound design suite: one-button multiband rig (Sub/Low-Mid/High-Mid/Air buckets split by phase-coherent Linkwitz-Riley 4th-order filters) + granular whoosh engine with Auto-Whoosh and Live performance modes, interactive envelope curve editor, per-bucket ingredient management and stem rendering.

version.author: Ed
version.changelog: Initial release: merges the multiband rig builder and the granular whoosh engine. Fixes the band-FX control bug: filters are located by robust filename+description matching with ValidatePtr2 guards and updated with native (Hz) parameter values while walking the rig folder structure.

reapack.name: ReaBlender_Filter.jsfx
reapack.desc: ReaBlender Filter Band — LR4 24 dB/oct 4-way splitter (LP/BP/HP)

metadata.description: Per-bucket Linkwitz-Riley 4th-order (24 dB/oct) band filter with four modes (Sub LP, Low-Mid BP, High-Mid BP, Air HP) across three crossovers. Broadcasts band RMS levels over shared gmem for the ReaBlender Visualizer. Installs to Effects/SoundDesignTools/.

reapack.name: ReaBlender_Brain.jsfx
reapack.desc: ReaBlender Brain — live whoosh envelope + doppler engine

metadata.description: Master whoosh envelope and doppler pan engine for the [ReaBlender] parent track. Lua writes the envelope shape and playhead as native parameters; the Brain renders them sample-accurately and broadcasts playhead/gain/pan over shared gmem.

reapack.name: ReaBlender_Visualizer.jsfx
reapack.desc: ReaBlender Visualizer — band meters + scope + playhead

metadata.description: Passthrough JSFX for the [ReaBlender] parent: scrolling output scope, violet/navy/amber/cyan band level meters fed by ReaBlender_Filter over shared gmem, plus the Brain's live playhead cursor and envelope gain dot.

version.author: Ed
version.changelog: Major rebuild: new Sequential sampling mode, Doppler envelope section, Resample to folder, and UI enhancements

reapack.name: CurveGenerator.lua
reapack.desc: Haptic curve generator — exports audio as Unreal/Unity/Godot curves

metadata.description: Turns a REAPER audio item into a haptic feedback curve and exports it for Unreal (CSV), Unity (AnimationCurve JSON) or Godot 4 (.tres)

reapack.name: Create_Or_Sync_Multiband_Rig.lua
reapack.desc: [legacy] Multiband splitting rig — LR4 band-split folder (Multipass-style)

metadata.description: Superseded by ReaBlender. Turns the selected track into a multiband host folder: items are cloned into color-coded [LOW]/[MID]/[HIGH] bucket children split by phase-coherent Linkwitz-Riley 4th-order (24 dB/oct) JSFX filters, summing flat into the parent (which keeps your FX chain plus an output visualizer). Re-run on the rig to open a control window with live crossover sliders. Values persist on the parent track.

version.author: Ed
version.changelog: CRITICAL FIX: TrackFX_SetParam takes native values (Hz), not normalized 0..1 — all cutoff writes were clamping to the slider minimums and band modes were mis-set. Apply now sends Hz directly; existing rigs should re-Apply or be recreated.

reapack.name: MB_Filter_Band.jsfx
reapack.desc: MB Filter Band — LR4 24 dB/oct band-split filter (LP/BP/HP)

metadata.description: Per-track Linkwitz-Riley 4th-order (24 dB/oct) band filter for multiband splitting: Low (LP), Mid (BP) or High (HP) mode with two crossover sliders. Installs to Effects/SoundDesignTools/ for the Create_Or_Sync_Multiband_Rig.lua script.

version.author: Ed
version.changelog: Added gmem band-level meter output for MB_Visualizer.jsfx.

reapack.name: MB_Visualizer.jsfx
reapack.desc: MB Rig Visualizer — output scope + per-band meters

metadata.description: Passthrough JSFX for the [MB Rig] parent folder: scrolling peak scope of the summed band output plus navy/amber/cyan level meters fed by the MB_Filter_Band instances via shared gmem.
